crossRefs.note: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?
Yahweh, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?
Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of…
They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works…
Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship…
Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.
You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea…
There is no one like you, Yahweh. You are great, and your name is great in might.
Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship…

parallels.note: For Yahweh is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.

translations.web: For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.
translations.bsb: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
translations.kjv: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.
translations.asv: For great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised: He also is to be feared above all gods.
